summary.headline: Method of Judging Nativities
summary.text: Method for judging nativities: examine each house cusp, the bodies and rays of fortunate and malefic stars within half their orbs, the sign lord, natural significators, parts and their lords, and the lords of the triplicity. These testimonies are weighed by strength, position, mixtures, applications, and impediments under canons approved by long experience.
